name: barbell incline shoulder raise
description: A straight-arm shoulder raise on an incline bench. Small shoulder-blade protraction lifts the bar slightly and works the serratus anterior.
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with your feet planted and hold the bar above your upper chest with straight arms.
Keep your elbows extended and your back against the pad.
Reach the bar upward a short distance by moving your shoulder blades forward, without turning it into a bench press.
Let your shoulder blades settle back against the bench under control and repeat.
